hero.title: Moments of Pure Wonder
hero.lead: Beyond standard sightseeing lies the true soul of Ceylon. Discover our three specialized travel pillars and handcrafted cultural, wellness, and wildlife encounters across the sacred island.

pillarsHead.title: Three Dedicated Signature Brands
pillarsHead.text: Whether your journey is centered on ancient sacred pilgrimages, deep holistic Ayurvedic rejuvenation, or thrilling wildlife expeditions, our specialized divisions design every moment with mastery.

pillars.alt: Lotus Artisan Sacred Heritage Sri Lanka
pillars.title: Lotus Artisan Travel
pillars.text: Crafted for discerning travelers and cultural connoisseurs. Delve into Sri Lanka's 3,000-year living Buddhist chronicles, UNESCO rock citadels, private temple chanting ceremonies, Geoffrey Bawa architectural masterworks, and intimate masterclasses with heritage artisans.

pillars.alt: Lotus Ayu Holistic Ayurveda Sri Lanka
pillars.title: Lotus Ayu Wellness
pillars.text: Rooted in centuries-old Ceylon Ayurvedic wisdom. Each bespoke retreat is curated under the direction of licensed Ayurvedic physicians (Vaidyas), offering traditional Panchakarma detoxification, custom herbal elixir treatments, silent forest meditation, and organic restorative nutrition.

pillars.alt: Lotus Nature Odyssey Wildlife Safari Sri Lanka
pillars.title: Lotus Nature Odyssey
pillars.text: Sri Lanka is an extraordinary biodiversity sanctuary. From tracking leopards and sloth bears in Yala to witnessing the world's largest gathering of Asian elephants in Minneriya, ethical Blue Whale catamaran sailings, and Sinharaja primary rainforest treks with senior field naturalists.

encountersHead.title: 12 Unforgettable Ceylon Encounters
encountersHead.text: Filter through our most sought-after private experiences, each seamlessly woven into your personalized itinerary.

encounters.alt: Evening Chanting at Temple of the Tooth
encounters.title: Evening Chanting & Oil Lamps
encounters.text: Attend the reverent evening Tevava drum offering and light earthen lamps amidst the golden roof of Sri Dalada Maligawa in Kandy.

encounters.alt: Dawn Meditation at Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi
encounters.title: Dawn Bodhi Tree Meditation
encounters.text: Experience profound morning stillness under the world's oldest historical tree, surrounded by silent pilgrims in white offering fresh lotus blossoms.

encounters.title: Private Leopard Tracking Safari
encounters.text: Custom luxury 4x4 safari with senior field naturalist into Yala's premier blocks, tracking apex leopards, sloth bears, and crocodiles at dawn.
encounters.meta: Location: Yala National Park · Duration: Half Day

encounters.title: The Great Elephant Gathering
encounters.text: Witness up to 300 Asian elephants congregate on the receding shores of the ancient Minneriya tank during the dry season—a world spectacle.

encounters.title: Physician Consultation & Shirodhara
encounters.text: Personal pulse diagnosis by an Ayurvedic doctor, followed by warm rhythmic herbal oil Shirodhara therapy to quiet mental chatter and restore balance.
encounters.meta: Location: Dedicated Retreats · Duration: Half Day

encounters.alt: Demodara Nine Arch Bridge Scenic Train
encounters.title: Nine Arch Bridge Observation Train
encounters.text: Ride Sri Lanka's famous hill-country railway through mist-wrapped pine forests, tea estates, and over the dramatic colonial brick viaduct in Ella.
encounters.meta: Location: Kandy to Ella · Duration: Half Day

encounters.title: Master Tea Taster Immersion
encounters.text: Stroll private estate tea rows with resident tea pluckers, followed by an artisanal tasting session of Silver Tips and Broken Orange Pekoe in Nuwara Eliya.

encounters.title: Private Catamaran Whale Watching
encounters.text: Sail off the south coast with a marine naturalist to respectfully observe the planet's largest creatures—Blue Whales and Spinner Dolphins.

encounters.title: Geoffrey Bawa Lunuganga Estate
encounters.text: Walk the private country estate of legendary tropical modernist Geoffrey Bawa, exploring fifty years of garden design and tranquil lakeside courtyards.

encounters.title: Traditional Artisan Guild Immersion
encounters.text: Meet 5th-generation master carvers shaping sacred Kaduru-wood masks and handloom weavers preserving ancient motifs along the south-west coast.

encounters.title: Ritigala Ancient Hermitage Walk
encounters.text: A guided silent walk through the ancient 1st-century BC strict monastery ruins of Ritigala, enveloped in cool evergreen canopy and medicinal herbs.

encounters.alt: Madu Ganga River Cinnamon Island Safari
encounters.title: Madu River & Cinnamon Island
encounters.text: Boat journey through 64 mangrove islands, visiting an ancient temple island and witnessing true Ceylon cinnamon peeling by generational growers.

plan.title: Weave These Encounters Into Your Private Tour
plan.text: Every Lotus Ceylon itinerary is crafted from scratch. Let us know which moments of wonder speak to your heart, and our travel designers will arrange private access and chauffeured ease.
